candidate.title: STRT
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina STRT schematic, captioned as an overview of STRT-Seq in the verified RNA collection page. STRT, STRT-Seq and the expanded Single-cell tagged reverse transcription name designate this one target here. The diagram shows three parallel cell-origin branches, indexed cDNA pooling, one PCR/purification block and cell-index-based sequence separation. CEL-Seq is a textual comparison, not a depicted alternative; associated kits, review methods and unshown bulk or modified applications are outside the target. This is schematic-level architecture, with no claim that every STRT version has identical preparation or that the final display establishes full-transcript coverage. All supplied primary-paper content is abstract-only; metadata and secondary catalogue evidence are identified separately.
